title.narrative: 1.2 Percentage of beneficiary households in target communities with increased agricultural production (disaggregated by sex of household head)

description.narrative: 1.2 Percentage of beneficiary households in target communities with increased agricultural production (disaggregated by sex of household head)

comment.narrative: This indicator primarily tracks the increase in agricultural production. Baseline data shows that 92.7 of households are involved in rice production and 16.8 are engaged in livestock rearing. With the implementation of our project interventions agricultural production and livestock rearing are expected to increase. The current agricultural production and livestock holdings are as followsAgricultural production Rice 9.4 kgdecVegetable 9.5 kgdecGinger 5.4 kgdecTurmeric 9.8 kgdecBanana 20.5 kgdecLivestock rearing Cow 1.78Goat 2.32Poultry 9.33Lamb 1.48Bird 11
Target for livestock rearing 30
